description: This file defines a React functional component for a checkout page in an e-commerce web application. It includes form handling for user contact, shipping, and payment details, displays an order summary, and manages navigation after order placement.

methods.name: Checkout
methods.description: React functional component representing the checkout page, managing form state, handling submission, and rendering order details.

methods.name: handleInputChange
methods.description: Updates form data state when user inputs change.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission by simulating an API call, clearing the cart, and navigating to the success page.
